It offered about 2.2 to 1 after costs.
trade_stories.what_happened: It went 1.00R against the position at worst and 0.04R in favour at best. It finished 1.00R down. FlowLock was in its initial state at the end.
trade_stories.what_it_learned: Lost 1.00R. It never worked at all, so the entry itself was the problem, not the exit. The stop was hit, which is the stop doing its job. Exited because [sl 0.94423].
